name: human-ai-work-system-next
description: Optional problem-formation, exploration, decision, evaluation and system methods

interface.longDescription: Five optional reusable methods inside native work: problem formation, adaptive exploration, bounded decision analysis, intended-use evaluation, and scoped Human-AI system development. This plugin is not a runtime, router, lifecycle, or complete provider universe.
defaultPrompt: Develop the missing problem or premise basis before a substantial investment in this work.
Explore materially different frames or solution mechanisms before committing to a direction.
Analyze this bounded material decision when a reusable decision method adds value.
Evaluate whether this exact work product is fit for its intended recipient and use.
Recover or diagnose this Human-AI work system when system-development work is actually required.
capabilities: Form a sufficient problem and next-investment basis
Explore distinct frames and solution mechanisms
Recover and improve Human-AI work systems
